headline: Replace me with your first headline
body: Write a couple of sentences here, same as you'd say them live on air. Keep it short and punchy — this is the text that'll actually show up on the News page.

headline: Second headline of the week
body: Copy this block, paste it above or below, and fill in a new date, headline and body to add another story. Most recent date shows first automatically.

headline: Third headline of the week
body: Dates use YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-18). The site sorts by date, so it doesn't matter what order the entries are in this file.
